title: Lightened Creamy Chicken Noodle Soup
originalTitle: Creamy but healthy chicken noodle soup
ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter or olive oil
2.5 cups cooked shredded chicken breast (or rotisserie chicken)
1 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1 bay leaf, fresh parsley, salt & pepper
instructions: Melt butter with olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Sauté diced onion, carrots, and celery for 6–7 minutes until softened, then stir in garlic for 1 minute.
Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and stir constantly for 1–2 minutes to cook out the raw flour taste.
Slowly whisk in the chicken broth and milk until smooth. Add thyme, oregano, bay leaf, salt, pepper, and shredded chicken.
Bring to a gentle boil, add uncooked egg noodles, and simmer uncovered for 8–10 minutes until noodles are tender and the broth is velvety and creamy without any heavy cream.
